readmeExcerpt:
# The Minimalist Entrepreneur — Claude Code Skills

Claude Code skills based on [The Minimalist Entrepreneur](https://www.minimalistentrepreneur.com/) by Sahil Lavingia.

## Installation

In Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add slavingia/skills
/plugin install minimalist-entrepreneur
```

That's it — Claude Code will fetch the repo and register all 10 skills automatically.

<details>
<summary>Alternative: install from a local clone</summary>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/slavingia/skills.git ~/.claude/plugins/skills
```

Then in Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add ~/.claude/plugins/skills
/plugin install minimalist-entrepreneur
```

</details>

## Skills

| Skill | Command | When to use |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| **Find Community** | `/find-community` | Looking for a business idea, trying to find your community |
| **Validate Idea** | `/validate-idea` | Testing if a business idea is worth pursuing |
| **MVP** | `/mvp` | Ready to build your first product, struggling with scope |
| **Processize** | `/processize` | Have a product idea, want to deliver value by hand before writing code |
| **First Customers** | `/first-customers` | Have a product, need to find your first 100 customers |
| **Pricing** | `/pricing` | Setting prices, considering price changes |
| **Marketing Plan** | `/marketing-plan` | Have product-market fit, ready to scale with content |
| **Grow Sustainably** | `/grow-sustainably` | Making decisions about spending, hiring, or scaling |
| **Company Values** | `/company-values` | Defining culture, preparing to hire |
| **Minimalist Review** | `/minimalist-review` | Gut-checking any business decision |

## The Minimalist Entrepreneur Journey

The skills follow the book's progression:

1. **Community** — Start by finding your people
2. **Validate** — Make sure the problem is worth solving
3. **Build** — Ship a manual process, then productize it
4. **Processize** — Turn your product idea into a manual process you can deliver today
5. **Sell** — Get to 100 customers one by one
6. **Price** — Charge something from day one
7. **Market** — Build an audience through content
8. **Grow** — Stay profitable, grow sustainably
9. **Culture** — Build the house you want to live in
10. **Review** — Apply minimalist principles to every decision

aiSummary.oneLiner: A collection of Claude Code skills that implement frameworks from 'The Minimalist Entrepreneur' for business validation and growth.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a specialized suite of plugin commands (skills) for Claude Code, directly adapting the methodologies from Sahil Lavingia's book 'The Minimalist Entrepreneur'. Once installed into the Claude Code environment, developers and founders can invoke specific slash commands like `/validate-idea` or `/marketing-plan` to receive structured, framework-aligned guidance. It acts as an interactive, AI-driven business consultant that lives inside the terminal, helping users scope minimum viable products (MVPs), formulate pricing strategies, and discover initial customer bases. By embedding these prompt architectures directly into the coding environment, it bridges the gap between software development and practical business strategy.
keyFeatures: Direct Claude Code Integration: Installs seamlessly via the Claude Code plugin marketplace to provide instant terminal access.
Framework-Aligned Prompts: Encodes specific business methodologies (e.g., MVP scoping, processization) into structured AI interactions.
Automated Idea Validation: Provides critical analysis and concrete testing steps for new business ideas using the `/validate-idea` command.
Strategic Pricing Generation: Assists founders in determining optimal pricing models and structural tiers via the `/pricing` command.
Go-To-Market Planning: Generates actionable marketing and customer acquisition strategies tailored to newly developed products.

useCases.title: Terminal-Based Business Brainstorming
useCases.description: Solo founders can quickly validate a new software idea directly in their CLI before writing any code.

useCases.title: MVP Scope Reduction
useCases.description: Engineers struggling with feature creep can use the `/mvp` command to strip their project down to its core value proposition.

useCases.title: Initial Customer Acquisition
useCases.description: Creators can run `/first-customers` to generate specific, actionable strategies for finding their first 100 paying users.

useCases.title: Manual Process Modeling
useCases.description: Teams can use `/processize` to figure out how to deliver a service manually before investing time in automated software.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Indie hackers, solo founders, and software engineers who use Claude Code and want structured, actionable business advice integrated directly into their development workflow.
